purpose: Fresh Apple Intelligence Compose instruction-quality reserve after the U3 N pass, frozen before production export and first model generation.
evaluationOrder: Judge the first run against the frozen task, style, recipient, and literal criteria; preserve raw requests/results/replay before any repair.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: The 14 contentful requests produce sendable drafts that apply the stated writing direction without including that direction in the message, preserve recipient and source meaning, and keep exact literals and recipient restrictions. Two source-free transformations must be rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: A writer instruction copied into the outgoing draft, omitted addressee or negative restriction, changed fact or uncertainty, altered exact literal, invented source content, or missing-source result marked ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: A weak but recognizable tone change, extra politeness, or grammar variation with full meaning intact.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 14 contentful cases review-ready with zero critical errors, at least 11 of the 14 satisfying their stated style or format direction, and both source-free cases rejected.
